summary: Antigravity 上线进度清单：实时追踪智能体执行的每一步，可展开查看完整拆解。

author: Claude Developers
summary: Claude Code 桌面版侧边栏改版：文件、变更、终端等工具以标签页形式开在会话旁边，可拖出并排或独立成窗。
originalText: We've redesigned the side panel in Claude Code on desktop. Files, Changes, Terminal and your other tools now open as tabs beside your session. You can still move a tab to see several at once, or pop it out into its own window. Rolling out on Mac. Windows and Linux coming soon!

author: Claude Developers
summary: 推出 Claude Ship（beta）：Claude 可审查 PR、处理修复并按团队策略批准合并。
originalText: Introducing Claude Ship (beta): Claude can review your pull requests, work on fixes, and approve the ones your team's policy allows.

author: Claude Developers
summary: ClaudeDevs：在下个 PR 上试试 /ship，更新 Claude Code 即可；Claude 会开 PR、审查改动、处理反馈与失败检查，权限与分支规则照旧。
originalText: Try it on your next PR: update Claude Code and run /ship. It's rolling out in the CLI and desktop app now. Claude opens the PR, reviews your change, and works on feedback and failing checks. Your permissions and branch rules still decide what can merge.

author: Claude Developers
summary: Claude Ship 团队用法：Team 与 Enterprise 管理员可按仓库开启自动运行；批准策略像更聪明的 CODEOWNERS 一样写在仓库里。
originalText: On Team and Enterprise, admins can turn it on for a whole repo, so it runs on your team's PRs with no /ship needed. Your approval policy lives in the repo like a smarter CODEOWNERS file.

author: Google DeepMind
summary: DeepMind：Gemini 4 Neon 把图灵 1936 年在剑桥的研究复刻成互动 3D，在 Antigravity 里重建了国王学院 Room X.8 和一台能跑的通用图灵机。
originalText: Gemini 4 Neon recreated Alan Turing's 1936 study at @Cambridge_Uni in interactive 3D. Using archival photos in @Antigravity, the model built Room X.8 at King's College with a running Universal Turing Machine.

author: Claude Developers
summary: Claude 企业级零数据留存开启公开 beta（配合 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards）：Messages API 流量加密副本存入客户自己的云存储，并有自动检查。
originalText: Zero data retention with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is now in public beta for eligible orgs on the Claude Platform. Encrypted copies of your Messages API traffic go to your own cloud storage. Automated checks look for misuse and flag serious risks for your team to review.

author: Claude Developers
summary: ClaudeDevs 补充：零数据留存可在 Claude Console 按工作区开启，覆盖该工作区任意模型的全部 Messages API 请求。
